Tiles like these Carrara matt white marble-effect tiles present a cost-effective alternative to authentic honed marble, expertly imitating the sumptuous marble aesthetic without the premium price tag. Our matt white marble tiles are made from practical, affordable porcelain rather than genuine marble, which means they're not only beautiful but highly practical too. On top of their affordability, marble-effect porcelain tiles are also durable and water-resistant, making them a sensible tile option for moisture-prone rooms like the kitchen or bathroom. The dainty vein detail on these matt white marble-effect tiles will instantly dial up the luxury on walls throughout the home. These tiles will pair well with monochromatic colour schemes and modern minimalist design themes where their flawless clean white colouring and luxurious marble-effect design can take centre stage. name: Golden Black Polished 60cm x 60cm Wall & Floor Tile
rawSpecsText: Give your home a dramatic makeover with these gorgeous black and gold tiles. Featuring realistic gold veining on black marble and a high-gloss finish, these tiles beautifully mimic real marble without the hefty price tag or extra upkeep - giving you that high-end finish for less. Perfect for creating luxury interiors in bathrooms, kitchens, living rooms and beyond, these black and gold marble tiles are guaranteed to give your home a sense of grandeur. Versatile style Marble has timeless appeal that has seen it used as an interior design material for centuries. So, with our black and gold marble tiles, you know you’re bringing time-honoured style into your living space that will outlast passing trends. From attention-grabbing kitchen splashbacks to striking bathroom floors, these tiles can be used on walls and floors throughout your home. Available in a 60cm x 60cm format, they’re an ideal choice for small and large tiled areas, creating minimal grout lines for a sleek and seamless finish. For a classic vibe, use these black and gold marble effect tiles in an Art Deco themed space with soft curves, gold accents and plush fabrics. Alternatively, bring them bang up to date with a minimalist, monochrome scheme incorporating white, glass and shiny chrome accents. Whatever decor style you have in mind, these versatile black and gold marble tiles can help you achieve your design vision. Practical perks Beyond their obvious beauty, these tiles also bring practical benefits galore to any living space: Durability: made from porcelain, these black and gold marble effect tiles have a hard, strong core that’s equipped to handle daily wear and tear on floors and walls Water resistance: porcelain also boasts excellent water resistance, making these tiles a practical choice for walk-in showers, bath surrounds, sink splashbacks and more Versatility: black and gold makes for a winning colour combination, and these tiles also pair well with a broad range of other colours and aesthetic styles - giving you plenty of versatility when it comes to creating an overall design theme Minimal upkeep: topped off with a super high-gloss finish, these marble-look tiles require no extra maintenance beyond a regular wipe down with standard cleaning products Start giving your home the TLC it deserves by introducing our luxurious black and gold marble floor and wall tiles. Order your tiles online now or request a small cut tile sample for 99p first so you can try before you buy. Secondly, white goes with almost any other colour, giving you options galore to pair your pretty honeycomb tiles with other shades. From kitchen splashbacks to bathroom walls and hallways, classic white metro tiles will make your walls look crisp, clean and forever on-trend. Inspired by the industrial aesthetic of the New York and London underground stations, our iconic 10cm x 20cm white metro tiles work brilliantly in bringing vintage, retro vibes into your home. With an enduring style, these versatile wall tiles aren’t just for period properties - they’ll look equally at home in ultra-modern settings, too. Styling versatility When it comes to decorating your home, you can’t get much more versatile than white brick tiles. From their classic 10cm x 20xm rectangular brick shape to their bevelled edges and colour, using white metro tiles for your interior wall updates can offer far more flexibility than you might think. Glossy white metro tiles bring texture and depth as standard, while their rectangular shape offers countless possibilities for incorporating different tiling patterns. This includes brick lay, herringbone and vertical or horizontal rows. This means you can keep your decor simple with all-white or black and white monochrome, without the worry of your living spaces ever looking boring. Alternatively, pair white metro brick tiles with almost any other colour, creating striking contrasts that bring depth and character. From pale and interesting pastel shades to bold and vibrant primary colours, white acts as the perfect base colour to enhance or tone down your colour palette as needed. But that’s not all this adaptable wall tile can do. White has the ability to make small, dark spaces feel bigger and brighter, especially in the form of a glossy white metro tile that will reflect even more light around the space! Material and finish practicality Our traditional 10cm x 20cm white gloss metro tiles are made from ceramic. Fired at high temperatures and finished with a robust glaze, these clay-based tiles provide the perfect practical material for covering walls throughout your home. From their hardness and durability to excellent water resistance and low-maintenance properties, with the correct installation, ceramic white brick tiles will keep your walls protected for years to come. An ever-popular tiling solution for practical splashbacks, 10cm x 20cm white gloss metro tiles are ideal for areas of the home prone to moisture, spills and splashes (like kitchens and bathrooms). But that’s not all - they’re just at home in hallways, living rooms, bedrooms and utility rooms, too! Given a glossy finish and a bevelled edge, keeping these white brick tiles in pristine condition is easy. A simple wipe down with water and a cleaning detergent will have them gleaming and bouncing light around the room in no time at all. If you’re on the hunt for a versatile, practical and evergreen tiling solution for your home, you really can’t go wrong with these 10cm x 20cm tiles. name: Weberset SPF White 20kg
rawSpecsText: Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is a flexible, cement-based polymer modified tile adhesive for internal & external use, suitable for use with underfloor heating. It is suitable for use with substrates subject to movement or expansion and is high-grab — non-slip for walls and floors. Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is available in grey or white, supplied in 20kg bags. Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive has extended open time for internal and external use and is suitable for fixing all types of ceramic wall and floor tiles, mosaics, marble, terrazzo, natural stone, brick slips and glass blocks in areas that will be dry or wet. It is particularly suited for situations where some movement, deflection or limited shrinkage is likely. Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is best suited for fixing ceramic or porcelain tiles, on to most common substrates: • Walls and floors • Interior and exterior situations • Underfloor heating • Undertile warming • Overboarded wooden floors • Low porosity tiles or substrates • Power-floated screeds • Tiling onto existing tiles Constraints: Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is not recommended for tiling onto single layer wooden floors, e.g. chipboard, tongued and grooved timber. Not recommended for tiles with resin backs. Please contact technical services for application advice. Preparation: Prior to using Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive ensure that all surfaces are clean, dry, sound and free from dust, grease or any contaminating barrier. Make good any unsound areas and remove flaky or peeling layers before tiling. Prime porous or dusty surfaces. Weber PR360 is normally recommended for most walls in dry areas. Weber AD250 is recommended for wood, wet areas and floors. Allow the primer to dry. Check before use that the colour of the adhesive does not cause staining or discolouration of light coloured or translucent tiles. Technical Data: Bed thickness: 3 – 6mm (may be exceeded in small areas only) Coverage (approx.): 9 kg/m2 (solid bed, 6 mm thick), 4.5 kg/m2 (solid bed, 3 mm thick), 3.0 kg/m2 (using a notched trowel with 6 x 6 mm notches at 12mm centres) Open time: 30 minutes Working time (pot life): 1 hour after mixing Set time: 24 hours – light foot traffic, full load after 48 hours Temperature resistance: –10°C to 100°C and frost resistant when set Water addition: 5 litres per 20kg Particle size: Up to approx. 0.5mm

rawSpecsText: For Internal Use Low Dust Technology 5 - 50mm Depth 1-2 Hours Set Time 25kg: 5L Mixing Ratio Tile After 2 Hours Coverage: 1.5m² @ 10mm Thickness Bag Size: 25kg Weberfloor Flex is a self-smoothing floor levelling compound — often incorrectly referred to as a self-levelling screed or self-levelling floor compound — which can be tiled onto and is an easy screed for applying onto floor substrates subject to some movement, such as wood or underfloor heating. Flowable liquid floor screed suitable for applying up to a depth of 5-50mm onto: - Floors with underfloor heating or under-tile warming. - Cement. - Concrete slabs. - Pre-cast elements. - Wooden flooring. - Existing ceramic tiles. - Existing rigid plastic tiles. - Floating floors (e.g. insulation board). - Bitumen residue* (* Best practice is to remove all bitumen prior to application). Things To Consider: - Do not use if floors are permanently damp or have rising dampness on friable or unstable floors in industrial areas. - Not suitable for exterior use. - When stored unopened in a cool, dry place at temperatures above 5°C, shelf life is 12 months from the date of manufacture.

rawSpecsText: This is a 4 bag deal - Get 4 for the price of 3 Colour: Black Size: 2mm N° of Pieces per Pack: 200 Also available in 1.5mm The main function of the RUBI Delta levelling system is to avoid the creation of installation eyebrows during the installation of ceramic tiles, both on floors and walls. The RUBI Delta levelling system also prevents the movement of the tiles during the setting of the adhesive and, during installation, the number of corrections in the position of the ceramic tile itself is reduced. The basic principle of the RUBI Delta levelling system is that of pressing the highest piece, until matching its position with the adjacent tiles, thus obtaining a substantial improvement of the surface flatness. The RUBI Delta levelling system is a system of wedges and flanges, recommended for formats of 30x30 cm or greater and varied thicknesses of up to 12, 15 or 20mm, depending on the model of flange used. The use of the RUBI Delta levelling system is fast, easy and intuitive. Once the installation is complete, the elements of the system are removed by impact (kick or mace), striking the flanges always in the direction of the joint. The RUBI Delta levelling system clamp is designed to be used both in installation work of horizontal (floor) and vertical (cladding) ceramic tiles. The main function of the RUBI Delta levelling system is to give the wedge the necessary pressure to allow the levelling of the ceramic tile; thus obtaining a homogeneous resulting flatness.

name: Oak Acoustic Wood Panel 240cm x 60cm x 21mm
rawSpecsText: Transform walls in your home or commercial space with our stylish and practical noise-cancelling acoustic wall panels. Complete with a stunning Scandi-style wood-effect finish, this 240cm x 60cm Oak wood slat wall panelling brings premium styling to walls with its sleek imitation oak wood grain design. To reduce unwanted background noise, improve ambience in your space and create a more intimate vibe in living rooms, meeting rooms, home offices, cafés, restaurants, recording studios and beyond, use our Oak acoustic wood panels as an interior wall cladding solution. These 240cm x 60cm Oak acoustic wall panels can be laid horizontally or vertically depending on your noise-reducing needs. Install the panels horizontally to absorb sound in the room, minimising echoes and reverb - or mount vertically to prevent sound from transferring through walls. Cover 15-30% of your walls with the wood panelling for best results, or up to 50% in gyms, home cinemas and other especially noisy spaces to keep sound transfer to a minimum. State-of-the-art wall panels for effective soundproofing All of our acoustic wall panels are made from 230kg/m3 high-density polyester felt fabric - a durable yet lightweight material which won't cause any damage to your walls. The soundproofing panelling is designed to reduce noise, eliminate sound impurities and improve speech intelligibility in homes and commercial spaces alike. We pride ourselves on using the finest quality soundproofing materials to ensure our acoustic wood panels are flame-retardant, odorless, non-toxic, corrosion-resistant and fade-resistant for a practical and hard-wearing wall cladding solution. In the noise reducing stakes, the acoustic foam panels perform well - achieving a noise reduction coefficient of 0.95 and an absorption coefficient of 0.8. Beyond its numerous soundproofing properties, the panelling can also be mounted in bedrooms and living rooms as an elegant decorative feature to transform drab walls into a striking design feature. The Technical Data sheet for this item can also be found here Interior and exterior use: Recommended for grouting of floors and walls in all types of ceramic (double-fired, single-fired, clinker, porcelain etc.), terracotta, stone material (natural stone, marble, granite, agglomerates etc.) and both glass and marble mosaic. Before grouting: Wait until the adhesive or mortar has completely hardened. The joints must be clean and free of dust, emptied down to at least 2/3 of the thickness of the tile. Preparation of the mix: While stirring, pour the powder into a clean, rust-free container. Mix the grout with a low-speed mixer to avoid air entrapment, until a smooth paste is formed. Let the mix stand for 3 minutes, then mix again briefly before use. Use the mix within 30 minutes of preparation. Application: Fill the joints with the mix, using an appropriate trowel or rubber spreader without leaving any gaps. Remove any excess by passing the trowel or spreader diagonally to the joint while the grout is still wet. Finishing: When the grout loses elasticity and becomes opaque, normally after about 15-30 minutes, wash off any excess with a damp sponge, working diagonally to the joints. Rinse the sponge frequently in clean water.

rawSpecsText: SOLD PER PACK (1.50 M2 Per Pack) Colour: Antique Oak Material: SPC Vinyl Finish: Matt Size (cm): 60cm x 12.5cm Suitability: Floor No of Planks Per Square Meter ( m 2 ) : 1 3.3 Availability: In Stock Transform floors in your home or commercial space with our exceptionally practical and super stylish SPC (stone plastic composite) flooring in a Concrete Bone stone-effect design complete with a smooth matt finish. Comprising four main layers - including a transparent wear layer on top for effective scratch resistance, a vinyl top coat which displays the SPC flooring's wood-effect finish, a durable, 100% waterproof SPC core for wear resistance, and an attached underlayment for sound reduction - our SPC flooring tiles are among the most practical flooring solutions available. On top of that, their realistic imitation wood grain finish presents a low-cost alternative to genuine hardwood flooring which can be out of reach for homeowners on a budget. The Concrete Bone design brings mixed grey colouring and a rustic concrete-effect finish to floors everywhere, from kitchens and bathrooms to offices, hotels and beyond. This stone-effect SPC vinyl flooring will pair perfectly with an ultra-modern minimalist space when coordinated with monochromatic furniture and fittings and carefully chosen metallic accents. An SPC vinyl has several main layers. Wear Layer – The wear layer is the top coating on the vinyl floor that is transparent. This adds scratch and stain resistance to the vinyl plank. Vinyl Top Coat – Each SPC vinyl floor will have a thin layer of vinyl attached to it. This layer is waterproof and will contain the pattern, texture and look of the floor. SPC Core – The SPC core is made by combining limestone powder and stabilizers to create a dimensionally stable and waterproof core. Attached Underlayment – SPC vinyl floors may or may not come with attached underlayment. These are usually included to help with sound reduction and add softness to the floor.Waterproof: This is one of the biggest factors in choosing an SPC vinyl. It is 100% waterproof, which means it can be installed in kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms and restaurants without worry! Stability in Temperature Fluctuations : With the stone construction, an SPC vinyl core is more stable in environments with temperature changes, such as cabins, homes with AC units and homes with humidity fluctuations. Appearance : SPC vinyl flooring can have a variety of looks, textures and styles. It will be hard to believe they are vinyls! DIY Installation : SPC vinyl flooring is a click-lock installation system. It is installed similarly to a regular vinyl and laminate with a tongue and groove installation. No glues or extra tools are required! This is a floor for the everyday DIY’er. Comfort: The SPC vinyl floor is going to feel more sturdy and cushioned under foot than a traditional vinyl due to the dense core and thickness of the plank. A thicker plank will give you more comfort. Also, some SPC vinyls will have attached underlayment that adds to the softness under foot. If it does not have attached underlayment, you can opt for an LVT specific underlayment to install over the subfloor. Sound: With the dense core, this plank tends to have a quieter sound. You will not hear a hollow sound when you walk on it. Affordability: SPC vinyl plank flooring is very budget friendly. Depending on the brand and features, you can find SPC vinyl in a variety of price ranges. Features like attached underlayment, texture and edges can increase a floors price. Easy Maintenance and Cleaning: An SPC vinyl will have the same cleaning and maintenance needs as a regular vinyl. These planks are designed to be easily cleaned with regular sweeping and mopping.

An SPC vinyl floor is still 100% waterproof, but adds stability, dent resistance and structure to vinyl plank flooring. An SPC vinyl has several main layers. Wear Layer – The wear layer is the top coating on the vinyl floor that is transparent. This adds scratch and stain resistance to the vinyl plank. Vinyl Top Coat – Each SPC vinyl floor will have a thin layer of vinyl attached to it. This layer is waterproof and will contain the pattern, texture and look of the floor. SPC Core – The SPC core is made by combining limestone powder and stabilizers to create a dimensionally stable and waterproof core. Attached Underlayment – SPC vinyl floors may or may not come with attached underlayment. Similar to WPC vinyl , an SPC vinyl is an engineered luxury vinyl that combines limestone and stabilizers to create an extremely durable core. An SPC vinyl floor is still 100% waterproof, but adds stability, dent resistance and structure to vinyl plank flooring. An SPC vinyl has several main layers. Wear Layer â€“ The wear layer is the top coating on the vinyl floor that is transparent. This adds scratch and stain resistance to the vinyl plank. Vinyl Top Coat â€“ Each SPC vinyl floor will have a thin layer of vinyl attached to it. This layer is waterproof and will contain the pattern, texture and look of the floor. SPC Core â€“ The SPC core is made by combining limestone powder and stabilizers to create a dimensionally stable and waterproof core. Attached Underlayment â€“ SPC vinyl floors may or may not come with attached underlayment. These are usually included to help with sound reduction and add softness to the floor.Waterproof: This is one of the biggest factors in choosing an SPC vinyl. It is 100% waterproof, which means it can be installed in kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms and restaurants without worry! Stability in Temperature Fluctuations : With the stone construction, an SPC vinyl core is more stable in environments with temperature changes, such as cabins, homes with AC units and homes with humidity fluctuations. Appearance : SPC vinyl flooring can have a variety of looks, textures and styles. It will be hard to believe they are vinyls! DIY Installation : SPC vinyl flooring is a click-lock installation system. It is installed similarly to a regular vinyl and laminate with a tongue and groove installation. No glues or extra tools are required! This is a floor for the everyday DIY’er. Comfort: The SPC vinyl floor is going to feel more sturdy and cushioned under foot than a traditional vinyl due to the dense core and thickness of the plank. A thicker plank will give you more comfort. Also, some SPC vinyls will have attached underlayment that adds to the softness under foot. If it does not have attached underlayment, you can opt for an LVT specific underlayment to install over the subfloor. Sound: With the dense core, this plank tends to have a quieter sound. You will not hear a hollow sound when you walk on it. Affordability: SPC vinyl plank flooring is very budget friendly. Depending on the brand and features, you can find SPC vinyl in a variety of price ranges. Features like attached underlayment, texture and edges can increase a floors price. Easy Maintenance and Cleaning: An SPC vinyl will have the same cleaning and maintenance needs as a regular vinyl. These planks are designed to be easily cleaned with regular sweeping and mopping.

rawSpecsText: Typically found in London and New York Underground stations, metro tiles have become a go-to decor choice for those who love industrial or vintage interior design. But there’s more to the metro tile than just traditional colours like white and black. If you’re in search of a metro tile that has all the iconic style and practical hallmarks of the original design in the guise of a vivid colour, our dark red metro tiles are just the ticket. Practical properties galore Choosing tiles to cover your walls will help ensure the longevity of your interior updates - our red metro tiles are no different. Mimicking the look of their original ancestors, our 10cm x 20cm dark red metro tiles come with a shiny, glossy finish and all the practical properties you’d expect from a modern ceramic tile, such as: Strength: manufactured from ceramic and fired at high temperatures and pressures, metro tiles are designed to last, delivering a scratch and stain-resistant tile that will last for years Water-repelling properties: due to their hardness and robust glazed finish, these ceramic tiles have low absorption levels, helping to repel water even in areas prone to moisture Easy-clean surface: their smooth, glossy finish makes life simple when it comes to cleaning your tiles. A damp cloth and cleaning agent will quickly remove everyday splashes and marks, leaving them gleaming Added dimensions: with a bevelled edge and shiny surface, red metro tiles can instantly add depth to your living space by bouncing more light around the room Amazingly adaptable style Given their heritage and colour that’s inspired by iconic London buses, it’s no surprise that red metro tiles are a top choice for period properties. With their striking hue and iconic profile, it’s easy to give living spaces an authentic yet colourful aesthetic which can be enhanced even more with matching classic border tiles. That’s not to say these tiles are limited to older properties though - far from it! They serve up timeless style wherever you choose to use them, including contemporary settings. Create textured, striking feature walls in modern kitchens, bathrooms and more and you’ll have an all-star interior with minimal effort. If you want to soften the colour palette, tone red down with a paler shade like white or cream. To inject some playful colour with a retro vibe into your home, order your red metro tiles online now. Or if you want to get a sample first to see how they look, you can get one from as little as 99p. rawSpecsText: If you're looking for something a little more offbeat than traditional square mosaic tiles, arrow-shaped mosaic tiles are the ideal alternative. Tessellating to create a striking pattern on walls or floors, our white arrow tiles are a slick, stylish, elegant design solution for your home or commercial enviroment. These white arrow mosaic tiles are as practical as they are beautiful, too. Being made from hardwearing, affordable ceramic with a lustrous, glossy finish, you'll find these tiles are highly durable and water-resistant, making them absolutely ideal for moisture-prone rooms of the house like kitchens and bathrooms. They're a popular design solution for kitchen sink splashbacks and bathroom shower surrounds alike, with their gleaming surface helping to bounce light around the space. rawSpecsText: Colour: Smoke Red Material: Porcelain Finish: Textured Matt Size (cm): 6cm x 25cm Thickness (mm): 9.5mm Suitability: Wall & Floor N° of tiles per square metre ( m 2 ) : 66.67 tiles The form of the Brick&More collection is inspired by the natural look of handmade bricks produced in earlier times. For this reason, the edges of the tiles are not perfectly straight. It would not be accurate to expect complete geometric symmetry in the Brick&More collection; slight variations in the edges and dimensions of the tiles are intentionally designed to create a more natural appearance. This surface variation results in a visually pleasing overall aesthetic once the product is applied. Used by humankind for thousands of years, this material has traditionally been laid using the stretcher bond technique. The herringbone pattern, examples of which can be seen in our catalog, is also an aesthetically appealing alternative. However, when tiles are installed too closely together with minimal joint spacing, the visual character of the product may not be fully appreciated. For this reason, a 1 cm joint gap is recommended.

rawSpecsText: If you're looking for something a little more offbeat than traditional square mosaic tiles, fan mosaic tiles are the ideal alternative. Tessellating to create an Art Deco inspired design on walls or floors, our white fan-shaped tiles are a slick, stylish, elegant design solution for your home or commercial enviroment. These white fan mosaic tiles are as practical as they are beautiful, too. Being made from ceramic, you'll find these tiles are highly durable and water-resistant, making them absolutely ideal for moisture-prone rooms of the house like kitchens and bathrooms. They're a popular design solution for kitchen sink splashbacks and bathroom shower surrounds alike, with a smooth matt finish for a sleek and sophisticated effect wherever they're used. Our matt white fan tiles are an ideal backdrop for minimalist and Scandinavian-inspired design schemes thanks to their clean, white colouring and timeless fan shape. Through their grout lines, they'll create a mesmerising Art Deco style pattern on your walls. You can pair these fan tiles with other light-coloured elements like furniture and fittings for a pristine, minimalist aesthetic, or contrast with carefully chosen accessories and soft furnishings in black or grey for an ultra-modern, monochrome design. Its elongated format - pointed at one end and rounded at the other - as well as the reliefs that run through the piece, reinforce this theme. This innovative collection of mosaic wall tiles is intended for projects designed to stand out, thanks to the lustrous, glossy finish and choice of five distinctive shades in this tile range. Our Alma mosaic tiles imitate the appearance of a bird's feather while also evoking fallen leaves and fishbones, offering a striking and unique alternative to traditional square, hexagonal or linear mosaics. This ochre orange design brings a refreshing pop of cool green colour to walls, complete with a light-reflecting glazed finish. All of the tiles in this range measure 8cm x 21.5cm, similar in proportion to a classic metro brick tile, making them well-suited to kitchen and bathroom sink splashbacks as well as shower surrounds and full-length feature walls. These great-value orange feather mosaic tiles are made from white body ceramic, which is among the most hygienic tile materials available (thanks to its exceptionally low porosity) while offering superior strength and durability compared with red body ceramic tile. Ceramic is also heat-resistant and eco-friendly, giving sustainably minded homeowners peace of mind when redecorating their walls. The burnt orange colour of our Alma Scale Ochre feather mosaic tiles will pair to perfection with primarily monochromatic spaces using pops of orange or red. Alternatively, if you're keen to go bold with your design scheme, you could incorporate soft furnishings and accessories in cool green or coral pink for a complementary colour clash.

name: SPC007RO SPC Vinyl Click Flooring Rustic Oak 18cm x 122cm SOLD PER PACK (1.9M2 Per Pack)
rawSpecsText: Sold per pack (2.19 m2 per pack) Transform floors in your home or commercial space with our exceptionally practical and super stylish SPC (stone plastic composite) flooring in a Rustic Oak wood-effect design complete with a smooth matt finish. Comprising four main layers - including a transparent wear layer on top for effective scratch resistance, a vinyl top coat which displays the SPC flooring's wood-effect finish, a durable, 100% waterproof SPC core for wear resistance, and an attached underlayment for sound reduction - our SPC flooring tiles are among the most practical flooring solutions available. On top of that, their realistic imitation wood grain finish presents a low-cost alternative to genuine hardwood flooring which can be out of reach for homeowners on a budget. The Rustic Oak design brings cool brown colouring to floors everywhere, from kitchens and bathrooms to offices, hotels and beyond. This wood-effect SPC vinyl flooring will pair perfectly with a vintage country-inspired or modern Scandi-style space when coordinated with monochromatic or neutral furniture and fittings and carefully chosen metallic accents.

rawSpecsText: Colour: Clear Size (ml): 500ml Approximate Coverage: With 2 coats, this should cover up to 5 m 2 Suitability: For ceramic tiles that have a porous crackle glaze. To be used on crackle glaze tiles and grout joints You can use the LTP Coverage Calculator to confirm how much you will need of this product. The Technical Data sheet can be found here . NOTE: Due to variations in crackle glaze tiles, always test the product first to ascertain the correct number of coats to be applied For interior use only: For ceramic tiles that have a porous crackle glaze and for use on the tile and grout joints. This product helps to protect tiles from penetration by water, dirt, oil, grease, limescale and other household contaminants. Directions for use: Ensure that the tile surface is clean and dry. Any tiles that are wet cut should be protected with at least one coat of sealer. Once the tiles have been fixed and before grouting, apply at least one coat of the sealer with a sponge or soft cloth, but then buff immediately into the surface using the LTP Buffing Cloth. This should be done until all excess is removed. Leave for a minimum of 2 hours before grouting with normal grouts. If coloured or pigmented grouts are to be used: Apply at least a further three coats and do not buff off the excess. Allow 2 hours between each coat. Grout in the joints and remove excess immediately using a sponge and water. Leave grout to harden (approximately 2 hours). Use LTP Grout Stain Remover and LTP Black Course Pad to de-bond remaining grout residue and sealer. Wipe off remaining residue with LTP Buffing Cloth. Optional: Once dry (minimum 24 hours), apply a further coat of sealer to the surface also covering the joints. After 48 hours the surface can be cleaned as normal. Use LTP Buffing Cloth to remove any excess from non-absorbent surfaces. Drying time: Approximately 30-40 minutes. Becomes fully effective after approximately 48 hours.

rawSpecsText: The metro tile does not age! This bevelled tile is found in many trendy places such as hipster coffee shops, modern lofts and chic Parisian flats. Even though this tile was created at the same time as the industrial design, it will continue being fashionable for a very long time! rawSpecsText: Lovers of all things rugged and industrial are sure to fall in love with our Roma Graphite decorative stone wall tiles. Made from manufactured stone in cool grey for a rustic 3D effect that brings instant character to walls, these tiles are destined for a contemporary full-length feature wall. Roma decorative stone tiles offer an ideal way to channel the atmosphere of the Eternal City: the buzz of marketplaces, the labyrinth of narrow alleys, the aroma of spices and freshly ground coffee. Cold colours like Grey or Graphite work best in minimalistic interiors, while warmer shades like Caramel and Sahara perfectly suit rooms that evoke lazy afternoons in a café by the Tiber. Manufactured (or artificial) stone tiles boast a realistic stone-effect finish ideal for modern and minimalistic or industrial-inspired spaces. On top of that, this unique tile material is also extremely durable, and resistant to stains, bacteria and moisture - making our decorative random stone wall tiles suitable for use throughout the home, even in moisture-prone areas like kitchens and bathrooms. Better yet, these Roma grey manufactured stone tiles can also be used indoors or outdoors thanks to their weatherproof finish. The Technical Data sheet for this item can also be found here Interior and exterior use: Recommended for grouting of floors and walls in all types of ceramic (double-fired, single-fired, clinker, porcelain etc.), terracotta, stone material (natural stone, marble, granite, agglomerates etc.) and both glass and marble mosaic. Before grouting: Wait until the adhesive or mortar has completely hardened. The joints must be clean and free of dust, emptied down to at least 2/3 of the thickness of the tile. Preparation of the mix: While stirring, pour the powder into a clean, rust-free container. Mix the grout with a low-speed mixer to avoid air entrapment, until a smooth paste is formed. Let the mix stand for 3 minutes, then mix again briefly before use. Use the mix within 30 minutes of preparation. Application: Fill the joints with the mix, using an appropriate trowel or rubber spreader without leaving any gaps. Remove any excess by passing the trowel or spreader diagonally to the joint while the grout is still wet. Finishing: When the grout loses elasticity and becomes opaque, normally after about 15-30 minutes, wash off any excess with a damp sponge, working diagonally to the joints. Rinse the sponge frequently in clean water.

name: Ultracare Grout Protector Spray 750ml
rawSpecsText: Water-based product for the protection of cementitious grouts. ADVANTAGES: Does not alter appearance, colour or shine of the surface and does not create a film over it Dries quickly The product grants durable stain protection. The treatment can be repeated over time Has excellent UV stability and retains good protective capacities even after multiple washings UltraCare Grout Protector is a stain-resistant protector specifically formulated for joints sealed with cementitious grouts and for polished porcelain tiles. The product is not suitable for treating surfaces different from those specified (use other products of the UltraCare range, referring to the respective Technical Sata Sheets). Always carry out a preliminary test on a hidden sample area, to evaluate the aesthetic result before applying the product on the whole surface. The treatment may be repeated after a certain period of time to maintain its effect, according to the type of material, the traffic load and wear level of the surface. Do not apply the product on exposed surfaces if rain is forecast within the next few hours after application. UltraCare Grout Protector is applied on completely cured cementitious grouts which already underwent after-laying acid cleaning. Curing times vary according to the type of grout used for filling the joints (always refer to the respective Technical Data Sheet). If the product is used in interior, make sure the room is well aerated during application and drying.

The Technical Data sheet for this item can also be found here Interior and exterior use: Recommended for grouting of floors and walls in all types of ceramic (double-fired, single-fired, clinker, porcelain etc.), terracotta, stone material (natural stone, marble, granite, agglomerates etc.) and both glass and marble mosaic. Before grouting: Wait until the adhesive or mortar has completely hardened. The joints must be clean and free of dust, emptied down to at least 2/3 of the thickness of the tile. Preparation of the mix: While stirring, pour the powder into a clean, rust-free container. Mix the grout with a low-speed mixer to avoid air entrapment, until a smooth paste is formed. Let the mix stand for 3 minutes, then mix again briefly before use. Use the mix within 30 minutes of preparation. Application: Fill the joints with the mix, using an appropriate trowel or rubber spreader without leaving any gaps. Remove any excess by passing the trowel or spreader diagonally to the joint while the grout is still wet. Finishing: When the grout loses elasticity and becomes opaque, normally after about 15-30 minutes, wash off any excess with a damp sponge, working diagonally to the joints. Rinse the sponge frequently in clean water.

rawSpecsText: Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is a flexible, cement-based polymer modified tile adhesive for internal & external use, suitable for use with underfloor heating. It is suitable for use with substrates subject to movement or expansion and is high-grab — non-slip for walls and floors. Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is available in grey or white, supplied in 20kg bags. Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive has extended open time for internal and external use and is suitable for fixing all types of ceramic wall and floor tiles, mosaics, marble, terrazzo, natural stone, brick slips and glass blocks in areas that will be dry or wet. It is particularly suited for situations where some movement, deflection or limited shrinkage is likely. Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is best suited for fixing ceramic or porcelain tiles, on to most common substrates: • Walls and floors • Interior and exterior situations • Underfloor heating • Undertile warming • Overboarded wooden floors • Low porosity tiles or substrates • Power-floated screeds • Tiling onto existing tiles Constraints: Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive is not recommended for tiling onto single layer wooden floors, e.g. chipboard, tongued and grooved timber. Not recommended for tiles with resin backs. Please contact technical services for application advice. Preparation: Prior to using Weberset SPF Tile Adhesive ensure that all surfaces are clean, dry, sound and free from dust, grease or any contaminating barrier. Make good any unsound areas and remove flaky or peeling layers before tiling. Prime porous or dusty surfaces. weber pr360 is normally recommended for most walls in dry areas. weber AD250 is recommended for wood, wet areas and floors. Allow the primer to dry. Check before use that the colour of the adhesive does not cause staining or discolouration of light coloured or translucent tiles. Technical Data: Bed thickness: 3 – 6mm (may be exceeded in small areas only) Coverage (approx.): 9 kg/m2 (solid bed, 6 mm thick), 4.5 kg/m2 (solid bed, 3 mm thick), 3.0 kg/m2 (using a notched trowel with 6 x 6 mm notches at 12mm centres) Open time: 30 minutes Working time (pot life): 1 hour after mixing Set time: 24 hours – light foot traffic, full load after 48 hours Temperature resistance: –10°C to 100°C and frost resistant when set Water addition: 5 litres per 20kg Particle size: Up to approx. 0.5mm

specs.Colour: White/Clear Size: 1.5mm N° of Pieces per Pack: 200 Also available in 2mm The main function of the RUBI Delta levelling system is to avoid the creation of instal

rawSpecsText: Colour: White/Clear Size: 1.5mm N° of Pieces per Pack: 200 Also available in 2mm The main function of the RUBI Delta levelling system is to avoid the creation of installation eyebrows during the installation of ceramic tiles, both on floors and walls. The RUBI Delta levelling system also prevents the movement of the tiles during the setting of the adhesive and, during installation, the number of corrections in the position of the ceramic tile itself is reduced. The basic principle of the RUBI Delta levelling system is that of pressing the highest piece, until matching its position with the adjacent tiles, thus obtaining a substantial improvement of the surface flatness. The RUBI Delta levelling system is a system of wedges and flanges, recommended for formats of 30x30 cm or greater and varied thicknesses of up to 12, 15 or 20mm, depending on the model of flange used. The use of the RUBI Delta levelling system is fast, easy and intuitive. Once the installation is complete, the elements of the system are removed by impact (kick or mace), striking the flanges always in the direction of the joint. The RUBI Delta levelling system clamp is designed to be used both in installation work of horizontal (floor) and vertical (cladding) ceramic tiles. The main function of the RUBI Delta levelling system is to give the wedge the necessary pressure to allow the levelling of the ceramic tile; thus obtaining a homogeneous resulting flatness.

rawSpecsText: RUBI Broca Drygres Premium Diamond Drill Bits are available in multiple sizes Size: 6mm Connection: M14 Threaded Connection (dry cut) Drilling Depth: 30mm Maximum Speed: 14000 RPM Suitability: Perfect for all types of tiles The average life of the drill bits always depends on the type of material, its thickness and correct cooling, and use. For a better finish and longer life of the bit, it is important to respect the correct turning speed and make a slight orbital movement throughout the drilling. The Drygres Premium range of diamond drill bits is perfect for drilling all types of tiles, especially porcelain stoneware, and other covering materials such as marble and granite. RUBI has used the vacuum brazed technology, which increases resistance to temperature and friction, to fix the diamond particles to the cutting area. Drygres Premium bits, with diameters 6 to 12mm, are perfect for fixing bathroom accessories or any type of decoration accessory on tiled surfaces. The rest of the diameters of the range of Drygres Premium diamond drill bits, from 20 to 85mm, have been designed mainly so that the tile fixer can obtain the best results when making the necessary drilling for sockets, pipes, drains, lights, etc. Drygres Premium diamond drill bits are dry cut and can be used, thanks to their M14 threaded connection, directly with a grinder or with an electric drill without a hammer, by using the drill adapter. In the diameters 6, 8, 10 and 12mm, the Premium Drygres contain wax inside. This wax melts during the use of the bit and facilitates the cooling and evacuation of the drilling debris (If the wax runs out, the bit can continue working. Only the total loss of the diamond indicates the end of the life of the bit).

name: 60 Grit Diamond Polishing Pad
rawSpecsText: Grit: 60 Grit Size: 55mm x 90mm Use: Wet or Dry Ideal for edge grinding and polishing, great for getting to complicated areas Also available in 120 grit The RUBI range of diamond rubber blocks are ideal for roughing and polishing edges, both cuts and surfaces of natural stone and ceramic tile. The RUBI diamond rubber studs are semi-flexible and their EVA rubber body allows excellent adaptation to the user's hand. The holding area has a lateral indentation that increases the ergonomics of the block and reduces hand fatigue during use. The diamond rubber pads have been designed to work manually on those areas where access with power tools is very difficult, such as interior angles, hollow areas or corners and for roughing and smoothing chipped or sharp edges. To achieve a good result, both the type of material and the state in which it is found must be taken into account. RUBI diamond rubber blocks can be used dry, but wet use is recommended, either by wetting the block or providing a source of continuous cooling. The RUBI range of diamond rubber pads comes in different granulometries to be able to carry out different polishing and finishing jobs. It is very important that, in polishing work, a gradual degradation is carried out using the different grains successively. Starting with the largest grain to the smallest. In roughing and/or edge smoothing work, the movement of the block must always go from the top (the most visible) to the bottom. This reduces the risk of chipping or damage to the material.

name: Delta Levelling System Fast-Fix Pliers
rawSpecsText: The main function of the RUBI Delta levelling system is to avoid the creation of installation gaps during the installation of ceramic tiles, both on floors and walls. The DELTA LS levelling system also prevents movement of the tiles during the setting of the adhesive and, during installation, the number of corrections in the position of the ceramic tile itself is reduced. The basic principle of the RUBI Delta levelling system is to press the highest piece until its position is equal to the adjacent tiles, thus obtaining a substantial improvement in surface flatness. The RUBI Delta levelling system is a system of wedges and flanges, recommended for formats of 30x30 cm or larger and varied thicknesses of up to 12, 15 or 20mm, depending on the flange model used. Using the RUBI Delta levelling system is quick, easy and intuitive. Once the installation is complete, the system elements are removed by impact (kick or hammer), always hitting the flanges in the direction of the joint. The RUBI Delta levelling system pliers are designed to be used for both horizontal (flooring) and vertical (covering) ceramic tile installation work. The main function of the RUBI Delta levelling system clamp is to give the wedge the necessary pressure to allow the ceramic tile to be levelled; thus obtaining a homogeneous resulting flatness.

Features: Advanced water management, with a tank of up to 19l Includes the zero dust system to ensure a safe working environment C3-Python System increases cooling efficiency, ensures easy cleaning of the blade and reduces water dispersion Compact and powerful The DT-250 MAX is a portable electric cutter ideal for ceramic floors and walls, including porcelain stoneware and other materials. Thanks to its compact design, it is perfect for repair or renovation work, as it allows us to make precise cuts and obtain high-quality finishes. It incorporates the C3 System Phyton to minimise water loss and allows us to direct the water output flow to the point where most need it, depending on the material you are going to cut. If you cut hard materials, it will focus the jet directly where the disc touches the ceramic, which is the point where the highest temperature will be produced, and if it is an abrasive construction material, we will place the water outlet on the top of the disc so that it cleans it effectively to deal with these materials that do not acquire as much temperature during cutting or require as much cooling. The zero dust system allows the DT-250 MAX to reduce the amount of suspended particles during cutting, improving safety and comfort during cutting. It incorporates an adjustable side stop from 0º to 45º to make repetitive cuts that together with the tilting head will allow us to make precise bevel or mitre cuts at 22.5º and 45º. In addition, it has the advantage of a head with a mitre saw, effective for those more precise cuts or simply where you have to adjust the height of the disc. The DT-250 MAX is designed to improve the comfort and portability of the machine, for this it includes a folding steel tube support with wheels, so transport will be easier as well as its storage. It has a water tank with a maximum capacity of 19 litres (5.02 gal) with a level indicator, this provides optimal cooling to prolong the life of the disc and improve the quality of the cut. The main aluminium table with a rubber surface, together with its side and rear extensions in reinforced plastic, results in great stability, less vibrations and more safety in each cut we make. To improve cutting precision, the DT-250 MAX incorporates a laser pointer where the path along which the disc will make the cut will be visible.

Features: Two cutting modes, manual and automatic Intelligent automatic advance with electronic control to adapt the engine to the blade, material type and thickness Improved blade performance where the machine adapts to the blade's needs for the best cut possible and to extend the life of the blade The DC-250 Smart Advance is an electric saw that automatically adapts to the needs of the job, ensuring optimal cuts at all times. The DC-250 Smart Advance is the first of its generation and thanks to its intelligent automatic feed with electronic control, the machine starts with predefined parameters and as it advances in the cut, the motor speed is adjusted according to the needs of the disc and the material, always ensuring the best possible finish. This innovative system offers four levels of adjustment, allowing the installer to choose between speed and precision depending on the type of work. What the new DC-250 Smart Advance offers us, unlike traditional manual control, are more uniform and high-quality cuts, as if they were guided by an expert hand. As it allows us to adjust the speed automatically according to the resistance encountered, the overall performance of the disc is increased, prolonging its useful life and avoiding or delaying its dulling. In addition, its integrated protection system stops the motor immediately in case the blade jams or becomes dull, ensuring safe and uninterrupted work. The DC-250 Smart Advance adapts to all levels of experience, which is why it has two operating modes: manual and automatic. For those who prefer a hands-on approach, manual mode allows full control over the cut. Automatic mode, on the other hand, allows you to rely on the machine's advanced technology, obtaining precise results without the need for constant adjustments. The new technology of the DC-250 Smart Advance offers us great capacity for intelligent adaptation, unsurpassed precision and an improved approach to safety, making it the best option on the market for professionals looking for comfort, efficiency and professionalism in every cut.

name: TX-1250 Max Tile Cutter
rawSpecsText: Features: High-precision scratching Great efficiency Reinforced components High separation power (1,200KG) Operatable with one hand Note: Cutting tiles thicker than 15mm isn't always possible using a manual cutter. For tiles thicker than 15mm, a wet saw should be considered. The TX-MAX range of professional manual cutters are perfect for intensive cutting of all types of ceramic tiles. Thanks to its high-performance multi-point separator and its rotating square system, the TX-MAX models allow easy and quick execution of angular cuts (from 0º to 45º) especially on porcelain stoneware tiles. Its great separation power (up to 1200 kg) allows the TX-MAX cutters to have excellent performance with extruded stoneware. The 30mm diameter tubular steel guides and the head with extra-long aluminium slides provide impressive structural robustness, making the most of the models with the highest cutting capacity (TX-1020 MAX and TX-1250 MAX). The advanced position of the roller increases visibility during scratching and separation, and the gripper incorporates a removable protector, which allows you to work on the most delicate surfaces without the risk of leaving marks. The separator mechanism allows for one-handed use, making it easy to lock and unlock the detent using a ratchet and trigger system. This system increases working performance, both in thin and thick materials (from 3 to 21mm without the protector, and up to 19 with the anti-mark protector that includes the footrest). As a complement to the floating table system, models 710 and 1020 are equipped with two additional side arms, to increase the support surface with large format tiles. The 1250 model has 4 arms (two on each side).

The Technical Data sheet can be found here . NOTE: Not for use on wetrooms or shower enclosures. Do not over-apply as too many coats may cause unsightly build up and/or reduce the efficiency of the product. Hardens after about an hour but will take a further three days to achieve full hardness and become fully water resistant. Always test first to establish the correct method of application and optimum number of coats before general use. Interior use only: Retains the 'just washed' look on glazed ceramic, porcelain, unpolished porcelain and vitrified quarry tiles. Easy to maintain. Low maintenance film forming sealer. Protects and embellishes the surface. Highly resistant to wear and stains. Facilitates maintenance and cleaning. Leave surfaces with a 'just washed' look. Directions for use: For newly installed surfaces, e nsure the surface to be treated is completely clean, dry and free of cement and grout stains (see LTP Grout Stain Remover ). For existing surfaces, first clean and degrease surfaces with LTP Grimex and rinse well. Leave to dry thoroughly (24 hours). Any retained moisture in the grout joint may cause the LTP Glaze Protector to dry opaque or prevent the seal from reaching full hardness. Application: Apply using a J cloth or sealant applicator pad. Put the contents into a separate container. Dip the cloth into the solution and wring out. Apply evenly to the surface without rubbing. Apply until an even and thin film is created (average. 3 times). Allow to dry (1 hour). For a glossier finish, further coats should be applied at right angles to the first (max. 6). Aftercare: Routinely sweep the floor. Use LTP Floorshine to clean and protect treated surfaces. In areas where the seal becomes worn, apply more LTP Glaze Protector. At some stage, complete renovation of the deal may be desired. In this case, use LTP Grimex to strip the iriginal seal before resealing. Avoid using strong detergents to wash surfaces treated with LTP Glaze Protector.

name: MAPEGUM WPS 10kg
rawSpecsText: Fast drying flexible liquid tanking membrane for the interior waterproofing of bathroom and shower walls and floors before installing ceramic tiles and natural stone. Fast drying flexible liquid membrane for waterproofing. WHERE TO USE Waterproofing indoor floor and wall surfaces that are not subject to rising damp. Flexible, anti-fracture membrane. Apply before the installation of ceramic tiles or stone material. Mapegum WPS may be used on the following: plasterboard, gypsum or cementitious render, lightweight cement block and marine-plywood; cementitious, anhydrite, wooden and magnesite substrates and existing ceramic and natural stone after the application of Eco Prim T primer. ADVANTAGES Product certified EC1 Plus by the GEV Institute (Gemeinschaft Emissions-kontrollierte Verlegewerkstoffe e.V) as a product with very low emission of volatile organic compounds. Ready to use. Rapid application. Floor coverings may be installed after just 12 hours. Excellent elongation properties. No reinforcement required Some application examples Waterproofing walls and floors in bathrooms and shower cubilces before laying ceramic tiles, natural stone and mosaic Waterproofing kitchen walls and floors and work tops before laying ceramic tiles and natural stone. TECHNICAL CHARACTERISTICS Mapegum WPS is a ready-to-use, solvent-free, one-component, grey-coloured paste with a base of synthetic resins in water dispersion. Mapegum WPS has a thixotropic consistency which makes it easy to apply on horizontal, sloping and vertical surfaces. After rapid evaporation of the water content, Mapegum WPS forms a flexible membrane which is not sticky and which is strong enough to withstand light pedestrian traffic. It also forms an excellent surface which bonds perfectly to adhesives used for laying ceramics, marble and natural stone. The flexibility of Mapegum WPS enables it to withstand normal expansion and contraction movements of the substrate due to temperature variations and vibrations. Thanks to the flexibility of Mapegum WPS , it acts as an anti-fracture membrane for substrates which are subject to light cracking (< 1 mm). Mapegum WPS is resistant to water, limewater (pH > 12), water which contains chlorides and normal household detergents and cleaning products. Systems based on the use of Mapegum WPS flexible membrane, on which various types of tiles have been laid using MAPEI cementitious-based adhesives (such as Granirapid, Keraflex and Adesilex P9) and water dispersion adhesives (Ultramastic III), have been certified for use in damp environments by the following institutes: SÃ¤urefliesner (Germany) Sp Swedish National Testing & Research Institute (Sweden) Norwegian Research and Building Institute (Norway) RECOMMENDATIONS Do not apply Mapegum WPS if the temperature is lower than +5°C. Create sloping surfaces where necessary to avoid the formation of puddles of water. Do not apply Mapegum WPS on damp cementitious substrates or on substrates which are subject to rising damp. Do not apply Mapegum WPS on bitumen or asphalt membranes which could bleed oil or plasticizers. Do not use Mapegum WPS on surfaces continuously immersed in liquid such as swimming pools, fountains, storage tanks, etc. Use Mapelastic or Mapelastic Smart for these types of application. Do not use Mapegum WPS to cover cracks which are subject to shearing movements. Mapegum WPS must be protected from abrasion caused by pedestrian traffic by installing ceramic tiles or stone material.

Mapeband is also available in ready-made internal and external corner sections along with Mapeband gaskets for pipes in bathrooms, kitchens, showers, etc. RECOMMENDATIONS For perfect sealing on corners use Mapeband 90° and 270° special corner pieces. For perfect sealing on pipes use Mapeband gaskets. In correspondence with T or cross joints, use the special Mapeband T or Mapeband Cross profiles. APPLICATION PROCEDURE Apply a thin layer of Mapelastic or Mapelastic Smart, at least 1 mm thick, to the sides of the corners and expansion joints to be waterproofed with Mapeband. Apply the fabric side of the Mapeband tape or special pieces over the fresh layer of Mapelastic or Mapelastic Smart, using a smooth trowel. It is essential that Mapelastic or Mapelastic Smart wet both sides of the Mapeband, also the rubber tape, for a width of several mm. For movement joints (i.e. in terraces) Mapeband must be positioned in the shape of an omega Î© (see overleaf): Mapeband can then be subjected to tension. name: Mapei Primer G 1KG
rawSpecsText: Primer G is a synthetic resin-based primer which, once applied to any surface, dries to form a flexible, compact, shiny coating which consolidates the surface, where needed. Primer G also improves the adhesion of smoothing compounds, paint, adhesive for wallpaper, adhesive for tiles and mortar for renders. The film of Primer G on the surface of gypsum or cement prevents any chemical reaction between sulphates and the cement aluminates of gypsum which, in the presence of moisture, leads to the formation of the salt “ettringite’’ which is the cause of the separation of the two elements. The use of Primer G when papering allows for reducing the substrate’s absorption and, as a result, the amount of glue used, thus making wallpaper removal much easier. When used before applying sprayable plasters, Primer G prevents over-rapid absorption of water by the substrate, prolongs workability time and helps prevent shrinkage cracks. When used before the application of self-levelling compounds, Primer G reduces the formation of air bubbles and helps prevent over-rapid drying making self-levelling easier. Primer G is not flammable and can therefore also be used in closed, unventilated environments without any precautions having to be taken.
